preconditions.expression: isinstance(stdin, str) and 0 < len(stdin) <= 100 and all(c.isalpha() or c == '_' for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: Input is a non-empty string of length at most 100, containing only letters (case-sensitive) and underscores.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if any(stdin.count(friend) == 1 for friend in ['Danil', 'Olya', 'Slava', 'Ann', 'Nikita']) else 'NO'
postconditions.description: Output is 'YES' if and only if exactly one of the friends' names ('Danil', 'Olya', 'Slava', 'Ann', 'Nikita') appears exactly once in the input string (case-sensitive).
